title: yt-dlp
description: Run upstream yt-dlp in bundled CPython WebAssembly. Archive extractor HTTP responses and all manual and automatic subtitle languages in their preferred original format.

YTDLP_FORMAT.description: Upstream yt-dlp format selector. Defaults to best video plus audio, falling back to a combined original.

YTDLP_FETCH_MEDIA.description: Fetch upstream-selected video/audio originals and HLS/DASH dependencies. Separate tracks merge without re-encoding when opened or downloaded; DRM is unsupported.

YTDLP_ALL_SUBTITLE_FORMATS.description: Fetch every original representation per language rather than upstream best (can multiply requests sevenfold).
